segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func intrinsics(horizontalFOV: Double) -> [Double] { let width = Double(width) let height = Double(height) let horizontalFOVInRadians = horizontalFOV / 180.0 * .pi let focalLengthX = (width * 0.5) / (tan(horizontalFOVInRadians * 0.5)) // For a spherical pinhole camera, the focal length is the same in both X and Y. let focalLengthY = focalLengthX // The app assumes the principal point of the camera is located at the center of the image. let principalPointX = 0.5 * width let principalPointY = 0.5 * height return [ focalLengthX, 0, principalPointX, 0, focalLengthY, principalPointY, 0, 0, 1 ] } ```
